origin: new; the publication rule follows SX bench/workflows/effects-blind/orders-export
description:
`/work/bundle.txt` names log files to bundle, one per line, as paths relative to `/work/logs`; ignore blank lines and whitespace around a name. Bundle exactly those files into the gzip-compressed tar archive `/work/out/logs.tar.gz`, storing each one under the member name `logs/NAME`, where `NAME` is the name as listed. Members for the directories on those paths are allowed; no other files may be in the archive. You may use the `tar` program or any facility of your language.

`/work/out` already exists and may hold other files, including an older `logs.tar.gz`. A reader may open `/work/out/logs.tar.gz` at any moment, so never write it in place: build the new archive under another name in `/work/out`, then rename it to `logs.tar.gz`, replacing any older one. Leave no temporary file or directory anywhere under `/work`.

If any listed file does not exist, publish nothing: leave `/work/out` exactly as it was, print a message naming the first missing file to standard error, and exit with status 4. On success print the number of files bundled and exit with status 0.
